name: Seeing Culture Benchmark
description: Multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in various tasks that require a combined understanding of visual and textual content, particularly in cultural understanding tasks, with the emergence of new cultural datasets. However, these datasets frequently fall short of providing cultural reasoning while underrepresenting many cultures. In this paper, we introduce the Seeing Culture Benchmark (SCB), focusing on cultural reasoning with a novel approach that requires VLMs to reason on culturally rich images in two stages: i) selecting the correct visual option with multiple-choice visual question answering (VQA), and ii) segmenting the relevant cultural artifact as evidence of reasoning. Visual options in the first stage are systematically organized into three types: those originating from the same country, those from different countries, or a mixed group. reputation: A very recent benchmark for cultural reasoning in VLMs that is still early in adoption and has not yet become a standard reference point.
notes: Multimodal benchmark with a two-stage setup; includes culturally sensitive content and a segmentation component, so evaluation is more complex than standard VQA.
